description: Replacement of garage door with new windows in connection with the conversion into habitable accommodation.Erection of proposed pitched roof including mezzanine level to the existing garage.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed development, due to its siting, form, design, scale and massing, would cause less than substantial harm to the character and appearance of the host property, neighbouring pair and to the West Putney Conservation Area, as well as being harmful to the amenity of neighbouring properties. There are no public benefits, or sufficient heritage benefits to outweigh this harm and therefore the proposals are considered to fail the statutory duty of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, the NPPF (2024), the London Plan (2021), policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Local Plan (2023), the Housing SPD (2016), the Historic Environment SPD (2016) and the West Putney Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy.

Reason : 2 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
